reaction: The time strip helped me understand how the bundles and tendons fit together.

expectation: I expect the tendons to connect muscles to the bones, possibly on both sides of the elbow.

effect: The completed arm shows how muscles on opposite sides pull to bend and straighten the same elbow.
reaction: The two views made the opposite pulls easy to picture.

mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the muscles to the skeleton was most worthwhile: the two views show why both muscles can pull but move the elbow in opposite directions.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the bones was a clear but fairly predictable step compared with seeing how the muscles move them.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the muscle cells join into long fibres, with supporting tissue continuing into tendon ends.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. Building the bundles was the only offered move, but the pictures gave the supporting tissue a clear purpose.

continue.text: I'd choose to continue: seeing the separate bone and muscle projects come together made me curious about how other body parts work together.
